name: tw_icn_sfga
author: sfborg/hive
description: TaxonWorks-derived validation rules for names governed by the ICN (col__code_id BOTANICAL). Each rule's description names the TaxonWorks class and method it is ported from. Statuses are matched as NOMEN ontology URIs in name.col__status_id. Relations are declared in hive_rules.json. Schema compatibility: SFGA v0.3.x.

rules.rule_name: Parent rank is higher than the rank
rules.error_message: The parent's rank must be higher than this taxon's rank.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the family group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be family-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the genus group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be genus-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the higher group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be higher-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the species group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be species-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related names share the nomenclatural code
rules.error_message: The two names in this relation are governed by different nomenclatural codes.

rules.rule_name: Status belongs to the name's code
rules.error_message: This status belongs to another nomenclatural code; ICN names need an ICN status.

rules.rule_name: Type of a family-group name is a genus-group name
rules.error_message: The type of a family-group name must be a genus-group name.

rules.rule_name: Type of a genus-group name is a species-group name
rules.error_message: The type of a genus-group name must be a species-group name.

rules.rule_name: Typified name is a family- or genus-group name
rules.error_message: Only family-group and genus-group names are typified by a name.

rules.rule_name: Type material belongs to a species-group name
rules.error_message: Type specimens can be designated only for species-group names.

rules.rule_name: Type status is used by the ICN
rules.error_message: This type status is not used under the ICN.
A class name must end in -opsida, -phyceae or -mycetes.
A family name must end in -aceae (or is one of the conserved alternative family names).

rules.rule_name: Gender set only on genus-group names
rules.error_message: Grammatical gender applies only to genus-group names.

rules.rule_name: Genus-group name does not end in -virus
rules.error_message: A genus-group name under the ICN must not end in -virus.
The infrageneric epithet must start with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters.

rules.rule_name: Infrageneric epithet has at least two letters
rules.error_message: The infrageneric epithet must be at least two letters long.

rules.rule_name: Genus-group name does not end in -virus
rules.error_message: A genus-group name under the ICN must not end in -virus.

rules.rule_name: Infraspecific epithet has at least two letters
rules.error_message: The infraspecific epithet must be at least two letters long.

rules.rule_name: Kingdom name is Plantae, Chromista or Fungi
rules.error_message: Under the ICN the kingdom name must be Plantae, Chromista or Fungi.
A order name must end in -ales.

rules.rule_name: Order name does not end in -virales
rules.error_message: A order name under the ICN must not end in -virales, which is a virus-name ending.
A phylum name must end in -phyta, -phycota or -mycota.

rules.rule_name: Specific epithet has at least two letters
rules.error_message: The specific epithet must be at least two letters long.
A subclass name must end in -idae, -phycidae or -mycetidae.

rules.rule_name: Subclass name does not end in -viridae
rules.error_message: A subclass name under the ICN must not end in -viridae, which is a virus-name ending.
A subfamily name must end in -oideae.
A suborder name must end in -ineae.

rules.rule_name: Suborder name does not end in -virineae
rules.error_message: A suborder name under the ICN must not end in -virineae, which is a virus-name ending.
A subphylum name must end in -phytina, -phycotina or -mycotina.
A subtribe name must end in -inae.

rules.rule_name: Subtribe name does not end in -virinae
rules.error_message: A subtribe name under the ICN must not end in -virinae, which is a virus-name ending.
A superorder name must end in -anae.

rules.rule_name: Superorder name does not end in -viranae
rules.error_message: A superorder name under the ICN must not end in -viranae, which is a virus-name ending.
A tribe name must end in -eae.

rules.rule_name: Tribe name does not end in -vireae
rules.error_message: A tribe name under the ICN must not end in -vireae, which is a virus-name ending.
The name must start with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters.
The name must start with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters.

rules.rule_name: Uninomial has at least two letters
rules.error_message: The name must be at least two letters long.

rules.rule_name: Unavailable or invalid name has no subordinate taxa
rules.warning_message: This taxon's name has an unavailable or invalid status, but other taxa are placed under it. Move the children to a valid taxon or correct the status.

rules.rule_name: Gender agreement set only on species-group names
rules.description: Ported from TaxonWorks TaxonNameClassification#sv_proper_classification with Latinized::PartOfSpeech applicable_ranks (app/models/taxon_name_classification/latinized/part_of_speech.rb).
rules.warning_message: Gender agreement (the part of speech of an epithet) applies only to species-group names.

rules.rule_name: Infrageneric epithet has no special characters
rules.warning_message: The infrageneric epithet should contain only letters; a hyphen is allowed only as two parts joined by one hyphen. Mark misspellings with the appropriate status instead.

rules.rule_name: Infraspecific epithet has no special characters
rules.warning_message: The infraspecific epithet should contain only letters; a hyphen is allowed only as two parts joined by one hyphen. Mark misspellings with the appropriate status instead.
The parent's name has an unavailable or invalid nomenclatural status. Move this taxon to the parent's valid name.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its family-group parent
rules.warning_message: This family-group name is older than its family-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its genus-group parent
rules.warning_message: This genus-group name is older than its genus-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its species-group parent
rules.warning_message: This species-group name is older than its species-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.
